scripts.build: npm run build -w @focusboard/core && npm run build -w @focusboard/svg-render && npm run build -w @focusboard/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:core && npm run test:svg && npm run test:cli
scripts.check: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/src/bin.js check examples/host/board.json --text
scripts.example: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/src/bin.js submit examples/host/board.json --out examples/host/out --page
scripts.overview: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/src/bin.js submit docs/overview/board.json --out docs/overview --text
